profile.name: Thorlabs PM100USB 光功率计
profile.description: 一款通过 USB 连接并使用 SCPI 指令控制的光功率计，用于配合已连接的光学传感器读取当前测量配置下的光功率等测量值。该设备支持设置平均采样次数、查询传感器信息以及读取校准相关信息，适合实验室中的激光与光学功率测量。
profile.description_en: A USB-connected, SCPI-controlled optical power meter used with a connected optical sensor to read optical power and related measurements under the current measurement configuration. It supports averaging setup, sensor information queries, and calibration-related information retrieval for laboratory laser and optical power measurements.
